stories.title: Russia frees ex-US marine after four years imprisonment on disputed charges
stories.summary: A former US military veteran who was imprisoned in Russia for more than four years on disputed charges and under abusive conditions was released on Tuesday. A group advocating for him said he was gravely ill and at risk of dying.
stories.post: 📰 NEWS: Russia frees ex-US marine after four years imprisonment on disputed charges. A former US military veteran who was imprisoned in Russia for more than four years on disputed charges and under abusive conditions was released on Tuesday. Source: France 24.
